shop.schema.v1.JsonNameCoverage.jsonsche.description:
JsonNameCoverage has fields whose JSON name differs from the proto name
 in ways a naive camelCase conversion gets wrong.

^(display_name)$.description: The ordinary case: the JSON name is displayName.

^(external_id)$.description:
json_name renames the JSON key; protobuf-es still names the property
 externalId.

^(metric_1st)$.description: A digit after the underscore: the JSON name is metric1st.

displayName.description: The ordinary case: the JSON name is displayName.

extId.description:
json_name renames the JSON key; protobuf-es still names the property
 externalId.

metric1st.description: A digit after the underscore: the JSON name is metric1st.
